subject.title: Voice-call plugin: hangup aborts in-flight tool calls (sessions_spawn killed before child initializes)

question: Should voice-call hangup preserve `sessions_spawn` child startup independently from the parent voice run, and should that be solved in the gateway/tool lifecycle or the voice-call plugin?
rationale: Current docs establish non-blocking subagents and explicit `/stop` cascading, but they do not define whether a phone hangup is a stop event or a transport teardown that should spare accepted background work.

options.title: Define Hangup-Safe Spawn Decoupling
options.body: Treat hangup as transport teardown, keep deliberate stop/reset cascading, and implement the narrow lifecycle boundary where accepted or in-flight child startup can finish.

options.title: Keep Hangup As Stop
options.body: Declare current cascading cancellation expected for voice calls and document that background work must be queued through cron or another detached path.

options.title: Use Plugin Grace Timeout
options.body: Add a voice-call-local wait/grace path before teardown, accepting more timing complexity and a weaker cross-channel contract.

recommendation.title: Define Hangup-Safe Spawn Decoupling
recommendation.body: Treat hangup as transport teardown, keep deliberate stop/reset cascading, and implement the narrow lifecycle boundary where accepted or in-flight child startup can finish.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the strongest voice-call ownership signal and can route the final boundary decision to subagent/gateway owners if needed.
